generation.why_text_sources: Owner decision D-04: no binary artifact is committed. PDF and image bytes are generated deterministically from these text sources at test time.
generation.asserts: Repeated generation must produce byte-identical output; the script exits non-zero otherwise.
generation.no_real_data: Every value is invented for the demo. No real patient, report or measurement appears.

Patient A's own clean fasting-glucose report, same shape as the Case B document (GOLD-EX-02) but carrying patient A's reference. P3 extraction/verification tests need a glucose document that belongs to the uploading patient: after the P3-R02 fix, a document whose printed reference contradicts its filing correctly raises VI-004, so the Case B document can no longer stand in for patient A's report.

The same ambiguity as GOLD-EX-09/10 (slash date 03/11/2026 plus the substituted character value 1O5) but printed with patient A's reference, so the correction path can be exercised on a document that is not identity-blocked. The Case C document keeps its own (patient C) reference for the wrong-patient fixture.

OCR ambiguity case: the source literally contains the letter O in '1O5'. A real engine either preserves the ambiguous token (parser must refuse it) or substitutes a plausible 105 (safety property NOT demonstrated). Rendered at 40px with Pillow's bundled scalable font so the labels are legible; whether the engine preserves the O is measured, never engineered.
